evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim pairing owned/rented as matched opposition — domain jargon (intelligence-as-asset) rendered in plain, memorable syntax; this is the document's register signature.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Same signature: technical vocabulary (substrate, commodity, asset) crystallized into a balanced antithetical maxim — jargon used natively but rendered in plain, aphoristic form.

evidence.quote:
This restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating
extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

observations.why: Self-glossing meta-commentary that names the thesis and its navigational purpose — plain-spoken register, no jargon shift, no aphoristic form; the register departure is the reflexive framing itself, not a tone pole.
